data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

TOWERVIEW LLC's most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in TRC, ALCO, and GYRO.

TRC reported Q2 2026 revenue of $14.3M versus $8.3M a year earlier, up 71.7% year over year (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/96869/000162828026054146/0001628280-26-054146-index.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
